label: Set overall budget — agree total spend cap with all contributing parties
notes: The most important decision before any booking. Clarifies whether contributions from parents change the total. Get agreement in writing.

label: Decide wedding date range — confirm no major religious or cultural conflicts
notes: Check religious calendars for both traditions if interfaith. Check major holidays, sports events, school calendars for out-of-town guests.

label: Create initial guest list — full list before any venue is booked
notes: Guest count drives venue, catering, and virtually every other cost. Do not book a venue before you know how many people are coming.

label: Book wedding planner if using one — research interfaith / multicultural specialists
notes: If using a planner, hire them now — they should be involved in all subsequent bookings. Confirm they have experience with your specific traditions.

label: Book venue(s) — ceremony and reception
notes: Largest single commitment. Confirm: capacity for full guest list, dates available, catering exclusivity or flexibility, cancellation policy.

label: Book photographer and videographer
notes: Most photographers require 12+ months advance booking for peak wedding season. Confirm they have experience with your traditions.

label: Book caterer
notes: Confirm dietary requirements: kosher, halal, vegetarian, vegan, allergy needs. Get itemised quote including service staff.

label: Book officiant(s)
notes: Who officiates and in what legal capacity? Confirm they are authorised to legally marry you in your jurisdiction.

label: Book music — DJ, band, or both
notes: For multi-event weddings, music needs differ per event. Book with a clear brief for each event.

label: Book florist
notes: Provide florist with full event list and decor vision. Request itemised quote per event.

label: Book hair and makeup artist
notes: Book for all events, not just the wedding day. Confirm experience with your look and skin tone.

label: Create wedding website and share URL with guests
notes: Include: event schedule, travel info, accommodation suggestions, registry link, RSVP link. Marigold guest website is created automatically from your dashboard.

label: Order wedding attire — allow time for fittings and alterations
notes: Custom and semi-custom attire: 4–6 months minimum. Schedule 2–3 fittings. Groom's attire typically requires less lead time.

label: Book accommodation block for out-of-town guests
notes: Negotiate a room block at a hotel near the venue. Guests book within the block and get a group rate. Release unsold rooms 30 days before.

label: Book transport — guest shuttles, wedding party transport
notes: Shuttle between hotel and venue. Bridal car. Groom transport. Map the logistics for each event.

label: Arrange wedding insurance
notes: Covers: vendor no-shows, venue cancellation, weather, illness. Approximately $200–$600 for comprehensive coverage. Worth it for weddings over $20,000.

label: Send save-the-dates
notes: 6 months minimum for local guests. 8–10 months for out-of-town or destination weddings. Include wedding website URL.

label: Book honeymoon — flights, accommodation, visas if required
notes: Book early for best prices. Check passport expiry and visa requirements. Allow 2–3 days after the last wedding event before departure.

label: Finalise ceremony programme
notes: Written programme shared with all vendors and families. Sequence of events, timings, music cues, readings, any audience participation.

label: Plan rehearsal dinner — venue, guest list, catering
notes: Night before the wedding. Close family and wedding party. Can be informal. Budget separately.

label: Order wedding invitations — allow time for printing and postage
notes: Send invitations 6–8 weeks before the wedding (after save-the-dates). For destination or multi-day weddings, allow more lead time for production.

label: Arrange wedding rings — measure, order, allow time for custom work
notes: Custom rings: 8–12 weeks minimum. Off-the-shelf: 4–6 weeks. Insure immediately upon purchase.

label: Book makeup and hair trials
notes: Trial 6–8 weeks before the wedding. Allows time for adjustments. Do not trial on the wedding week — allow recovery time.

label: Plan seating arrangement — initial draft
notes: Create seating chart draft. Identify family tensions or sensitivities early. For multi-tradition weddings: consider cultural norms around seating (elder tables, family mixing).

label: Send wedding invitations
notes: 8 weeks before the wedding. Include RSVP deadline (4 weeks before). Include Marigold guest website URL for RSVP.

label: Confirm all vendor bookings and day-of details
notes: Written confirmation: arrival times, setup requirements, parking, payment schedule, emergency contact numbers.

label: Arrange gifts for wedding party, parents, and key helpers
notes: Budget $25–$150 per person. Order early to allow personalisation and delivery time.

label: Plan honeymoon packing — documents, currency, travel adapters
notes: Check visa requirements, travel insurance, medication needs, vaccinations if required.

label: Chase outstanding RSVPs
notes: Call or message anyone who has not responded. Final guest count needed 3 weeks before for catering.

label: Finalise seating chart and share with caterer and venue
notes: Final seating chart to caterer for place cards and service planning.

label: Prepare wedding day emergency kit
notes: Safety pins, stain remover, pain relief, blister plasters, phone charger, cash, snacks, sewing kit, double-sided tape.

label: Prepare vendor payment schedule — who gets paid when
notes: Most vendors require final payment 2–4 weeks before. Create a payment calendar. Confirm which accept bank transfer vs cheque vs card.

label: Deliver day-of timeline to all vendors
notes: Minute-by-minute schedule. Every vendor gets a version relevant to their role. Include all contacts and emergency numbers.

label: Confirm honeymoon bookings and transport to airport/station
notes: Reconfirm flights, hotels, transfers. Check in online where possible.

label: Break-in new shoes
notes: Wear ceremony shoes at home for several days. Blisters on the wedding day are a genuine hazard.

label: Send thank you notes — within 3 months
notes: Handwritten thank you notes to all guests who gave gifts. Also: venue, vendors who went above and beyond.

label: Name change process if applicable — notify relevant authorities
notes: Passport, driving licence, bank accounts, employer, HMRC/IRS, electoral roll, GP/doctor. Start within 30 days of receiving marriage certificate.

label: Store marriage certificate and all wedding documents safely
notes: Original marriage certificate: keep in a fireproof box or bank safe deposit. Photograph and store digitally. You will need it for name change and legal processes.

label: Review and submit vendor reviews on Marigold
notes: Your verified review helps future interfaith and multicultural couples find the right vendors. Takes 10 minutes. Unlocks your post-wedding gallery feature.
